homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym, and T composes no other entity under the name: all six cards are libcom.org pages. 'libcom.org' and 'libcom library' are the census's other names for the entity, and 'enrager.net' its former name (B10 F41); the Collections is one section of the site libcom.org, and the row's entity is the index with the site whose index it is.
distinct_entities: the Anarchist Youth Network and the Anarchist Federation (Britain), from whose London group the enrager.net collective split (B10 F42)
Solidarity (London), Cornelius Castoriadis ('Paul Cardan'), Red Notes and News and Letters, whose texts the site carries (B7 F25, B8 F26; #1725's Red Notes citation)
Spunk Library and Anarchy Archives, the anarchist web archives Wikipedia lists under See also (B10, not ledgered)

the Marxists Internet Archive, the Encyclopedia of Anti-Revisionism On-Line and the Amiel Melburn Trust Archive (banmarchive), the census's neighbouring entities, each its own /non row (rows/marxists-internet-archive.json, rows/erol.json, rows/amiel-melburn-trust-archive.json, built in parallel); #1725 cites banmarchive.org.uk for the New Reasoner (line 178)
the Collections' tabs (Archives, Galleries, Blogs, Reading guides) as sections of the entity, never entities of their own

Collections; biographies and thinkers; archives; galleries; reading guides. Six cards, all libcom.org.
